entities.summary: Period of korean history (892–936), during which the southern korean peninsula was fragmented into three states (taebong, hubaekje, and silla), until they were eventually reunified by goryeo (892 CE – 936 CE). Later Three Kingdoms is a historical period associated with Asia, spanning 892 CE to 936 CE.
